expressions.en: I will follow up on this.

expressions.bm_formal: Bolehkah tuan/puan jelaskan dengan lebih lanjut?
Saya memohon maaf atas kelewatan ini.

work.scenario: You are a project manager needing to finalize a client presentation. You need to request the latest sales report from a team member, follow up on a pending design mock-up, and then schedule a final review meeting with the team.
key_phrases: Mohon hantarkan laporan jualan terkini kepada saya.
Saya akan susul status mock-up rekaan.
Marilah kita aturkan satu mesyuarat semakan akhir.

life.scenario: You are organizing a surprise birthday party for a friend. You've asked another friend to bring the cake, but haven't heard back. You need to clarify if they're still bringing it, apologize for being late to the setup, and thank another friend for helping with decorations.
key_phrases: Maksud kau, kau masih bawa kek ke?

tech.scenario: You are a tech support agent assisting a user who reported an issue with a new software update. You need to ask the user to send you a screenshot of the error, clarify the exact steps they took to reproduce the bug, and thank them for their patience and cooperation while you investigate.
key_phrases: Mohon hantarkan tangkapan skrin ralat kepada saya.
Bolehkah tuan/puan jelaskan langkah-langkah untuk menghasilkan ralat itu?
Terima kasih atas kerjasama tuan/puan dan kesabaran anda.
